steps: 1. Open your web browser and go to the official portal: https://aris3.udsm.ac.tz
2. Log in using your UDSM Registration Number / Username and Password.
3. Navigate to the left side menu and click on 'Course Registration'.
4. Select the active Academic Year and Semester.
5. Click 'Add Courses' to view the list of Core (compulsory) and Elective subjects for your degree program.
6. Select your respective core courses and chosen electives for the semester.
7. Click the 'Save / Register' button to submit your selections.
8. Print or download your registered Course Form (Form No. 1) for your department's records.
course_registration.prerequisites: Ensure you have paid the required tuition fee installment and completed medical registration, otherwise course registration may be locked on ARIS.
